description: verifyHandoffForDevice (protocol.md §5.6.5): may a device that pinned G1 pin the successor? Each case gives the request, the device's pin, its public key, its own receipt and optionally G1's completion; `expected` is ok (with completed, late) or the first failing code

cases.name: approved-in-window
cases.description: own approving receipt inside the window, completion supplied

cases.name: approved-no-completion
cases.description: own approving receipt inside the window; the device pins the successor before the move completes

cases.name: late-with-completion
cases.description: a phone that missed the window approves the completed move later; the completion names it

cases.name: late-without-completion
cases.description: a late receipt counts only with the completion

cases.name: late-not-listed
cases.description: a late receipt from a device the completion does not name

cases.name: before-issue
cases.description: receipt signed more than 60 s before the handoff was issued

cases.name: signature-over-other-bytes
cases.description: canonical bytes G1 did not sign, with G1's signature from the real handoff

cases.name: signed-by-successor
cases.description: the request is signed by another key than the pinned one

cases.name: other-gateway-pin
cases.description: the device's pin is for another gateway

cases.name: not-a-handoff
cases.description: a G1-signed approval request for another tool

cases.name: unsupported-version
cases.description: template_version 2, which this format does not define

cases.name: tier-2
cases.description: a handoff is tier 3

cases.name: extra-argument
cases.description: args_resolved has a member the format does not define

cases.name: successor-id-not-thumbprint
cases.description: successor_gateway_id is not the thumbprint of successor_public_key

cases.name: successor-is-self
cases.description: a gateway handing off to itself

cases.name: receipt-from-other-device
cases.description: the receipt was signed by another device

cases.name: receipt-for-other-action
cases.description: the receipt names another action_id

cases.name: approver-mismatch
cases.description: the receipt names another approver than the pin

cases.name: denied
cases.description: the device denied the handoff

cases.name: receipt-over-other-bytes
cases.description: the receipt signs another hash

cases.name: bad-receipt-signature
cases.description: the receipt's signature is over another signing input

cases.name: completion-altered
cases.description: the completion was changed after G1 signed it

cases.name: completion-not-after-head
cases.description: a completion whose final_seq is not after the handoff's ledger head
